title: Lior and the Hollow
author: Quentin Underhill
blurb: Casper Joubert, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
